hero.caption: The Dixie Travel Plaza, Dixie Truck Stop or Dixie Trucker's Home in McLean was established by J.P. Walters and John Geske in 1928 on old US Route 66 in Illinois as a small sandwich stand in a truck mechanic's garage. This section of U.S. Route 66 is now part of Interstate 55.

images.caption: The Village of Mclean is in Mclean County on old Route 66 South of Bloomington Illinois. The town's turn of the century community building was designed by Bloomington's famous architect, Pillsbury. The structure is dated 1917.
